features.title: A better place to read
features.text: Reader mode clears away page furniture. A bundled PDF viewer keeps documents inside the browser.
features: Reader mode keeps the original article address in history
PDF navigation, search, zoom, password entry and original-file downloads
Native color, date and time pickers

features.title: Bring your browser tools
features.text: Open an add-on’s page on Firefox Add-ons or Chrome Web Store and Summit adds an install card to the top of the page. Review the requested access in a native dialog before anything runs, or load a local extension package.
features: Install Extension on the store page; once installed, the card offers Manage Extension
Firefox packages are checked against Mozilla’s published size and SHA-256 and update from the same store; signatures are not verified, so install only what you trust
Toolbar actions, popups and restoration across restarts
uBlock Origin and Dark Reader have passed native runtime suites; 1Password sign-in, inline filling and passkeys have been verified for tested versions

features.title: Video, streaming and graphics
features.text: Modern WebKit works with airOS GPU drivers and video decoders, using software paths when acceleration is unavailable.
features: WebGL 1/2 and accelerated page compositing on supported GPUs
MediaSource streaming and direct MPEG-DASH with seeking, adaptive quality and live refresh
Clear Key encrypted media with temporary sessions; Widevine, PlayReady and FairPlay are unsupported

features.title: Control over each site
features.text: Private windows, browsing-data controls and native website permissions put common choices close to hand.
features: Origin-scoped permission prompts for device access
WebUSB and Web Bluetooth implementations; physical transfer/GATT coverage remains limited

features.title: See what a page is doing
features.text: Inspect a page, read its JavaScript console and investigate network requests from native developer tools.
features: Page inspector, console and network request views
Optional built-in MCP server for local debugging tools
Inspect tabs, processes, memory, rendering, media and extensions; MCP is off by default
